description: Known answer for the trace.command delta_digest (ADR-075 §4; observation.schema.json TraceDecision): SHA-256 of the canonical bytes of a StateDelta, here one move's entity.transfer. canonical was produced by Python json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False) and sha256 by shasum -a 256 over its UTF-8 bytes, never by the kernels.
